title: Mr. Clean
genre: เรื่องเล่าขำ ๆ
text:
Last month, my mother bought a robot vacuum. She was so excited that she gave it a name: Mr. Clean. On its first day, Mr. Clean (1) around the living room happily while we watched. Then it found my little brother's sock and (2) it. The machine stopped and made a sad beeping sound. We had to (3) it upside down to pull the sock out.
The next day was worse. Our cat, (4) name is Lucky, had never seen a moving machine before. She jumped on top of it, and Mr. Clean drove around the house (5) Lucky sat on it like a queen. My brother recorded a video and (6) it online. By evening, it (7) by more than 10,000 people. Now our cat is (8) famous than any of us. My mother says Mr. Clean is the best thing she (9) bought. I think she likes it more than (10) do.

items.stem: (1) Clean ___ around the living room happily while we watched.
why_wrong: moves เป็นปัจจุบัน
moving ไม่ใช่กริยาแท้
was moved = ถูกย้าย ความหมายผิด
items.explanation_th: เรื่องเล่าอดีต → moved

items.stem: (2) Then it found my little brother's sock and ___ it.
why_wrong: was swallowed = ถูกกลืน ความหมายกลับ
items.explanation_th: found … and swallowed (V2 ขนาน)

items.stem: (3) We had to ___ it upside down to pull the sock out.
(4) Our cat, ___ name is Lucky, had never seen a moving machine before.
items.explanation_th: ชื่อของแมว → whose name

items.stem: (5) Clean drove around the house ___ Lucky sat on it like a queen.
why_wrong: during ต้องตามด้วยคำนาม
so ไม่สมเหตุผล
unless ไม่สมเหตุผล
items.explanation_th: ขณะที่แมวนั่งอยู่ + ประโยค → while

items.stem: (6) My brother recorded a video and ___ it online.
why_wrong: to post ไม่ขนาน

items.stem: (7) By evening, it ___ by more than 10,000 people.
why_wrong: has watched = วิดีโอดู ผิด
watched = วิดีโอดู ผิด
items.explanation_th: By evening (อดีต) + วิดีโอถูกดู → had been watched

items.stem: (8) Now our cat is ___ famous than any of us.
why_wrong: most ใช้กับขั้นสุด

items.stem: (9) Clean is the best thing she ___ bought.
why_wrong: had ever ใช้กับเรื่องเล่าอดีต แต่ประโยคเป็นปัจจุบัน (says)
ลำดับคำผิด
was ever bought ความหมายผิด
items.explanation_th: the best … she has ever bought (present perfect)

items.stem: (10) I think she likes it more than ___ do.
items.explanation_th: more than we do = มากกว่าที่พวกเราชอบ
